role: Shared UI-test harness for the whole EmuquUITests target (timing scale, English launch args, accessibility-identifier constants, element lookup, tab/More navigation, first-run gate walking) plus the EmuquUITests smoke suite (tabs, dashboard, record, settings, history, paywall, disclaimer, Flo) and UITestTimingTests pinning the timing scale.
types: UITestTiming: enum — global wait multiplier (scale=2) and s() to widen deadlines
UITestLanguage: enum — launch args forcing en/en_US
UITestID: enum — string constants mirroring app .accessibilityIdentifier values and tab titles
UITestFind: enum — element lookup/tap helpers tolerant of SwiftUI identifier forwarding
UITestNav: enum — tab selection and More/Dashboard navigation with retries
UITestLaunch: enum (+ extension) — walks disclaimer/onboarding/paywall gates; background-to-persist
EmuquUITests: class — XCTestCase smoke suite of main flows
toplevel: Static constant tables only: UITestID identifiers (all verified to appear as string literals in Emuqu/ sources), tab titles (tabCoachTitle='Flo'), gate lists in UITestLaunch, and EmuquUITests tab tables. UITestTiming.scale is a hardcoded 2 (comment lines 16-24 explains env var TEST_RUNNER_UITEST_TIMEOUT_SCALE did not reach the runner).

units.does: Returns seconds * UITestTiming.scale (2), widening every wait deadline in the target.
Returns the tab-bar button whose identifier matches, else the first tab-bar button whose label BEGINSWITH[c] the title (SwiftUI does not forward .accessibilityIdentifier to tab-bar buttons).

branches.effect: true: return it; false: fall back to label BEGINSWITH[c] title firstMatch (which may not exist)

units.does: Returns whether an element exists, is enabled, has a frame >1x1 intersecting the app frame, and then whether XCUITest reports it hittable. That sees some occlusion but not all: on iOS 26 a tab bar under a fullScreenCover reports hittable (the doc says so and points to checking the cover's elements or a tap's effect instead).

branches.cond: frame does not intersect app frame
branches.effect: return false; otherwise return element.isHittable (can still raise mid-transition)

units.does: Taps the centre of an element by normalized coordinate after validating existence, enabled state and a real frame inside the app; never asks isHittable. Returns whether a tap was sent (not whether it landed).

branches.effect: return false; otherwise coordinate tap and return true

units.does: Returns app.debugDescription, truncated to `limit` (2000) characters with a '… (truncated)' suffix, for failure messages.

branches.effect: true: whole dump; false: first `limit` chars + truncation marker

units.does: Waits for existence, then polls until the element has a >1pt frame and is enabled and coordinate-taps its centre; returns whether a tap happened. Does not check that the frame is inside the window.

branches.effect: coordinate tap, return true; else re-wait 1s (0.5*scale) and retry; after deadline return false

units.does: If the Flo AI-disclosure accept button (assistant.disclaimerAccept) appears within timeout, swipes up to 4 times until its frame is inside the first window, then taps it via tapWhenReady; returns whether tapped (false if no disclosure).

branches.cond: accept button does not appear within timeout
accept frame not inside window and fewer than 4 swipes
branches.effect: swipe up and repeat; then tapWhenReady

units.does: Returns the first descendant of any element type whose identifier equals `identifier`.

Polls until timeout across six candidate queries (buttons/cells/otherElements/staticTexts by identifier, then buttons/cells whose label CONTAINS[c] label) and returns the first that exists; if none by the deadline returns app.buttons[identifier].

branches.effect: keep polling all candidates (busy loop with no sleep)

units.does: Waits for the tab bar and the tab button, then up to `attempts` times polls hittability (3s*scale), coordinate-taps the tab via tapSafely and waits (3*attempt s*scale) for an element carrying the tab identifier (which SwiftUI puts on the tab content). Returns whether the content appeared; final return is content.exists.

branches.cond: tab not safely hittable and before deadline

branches.effect: continue to next attempt without tapping
return true; else next attempt; after all attempts return content.exists

units.does: Waits for any cell (or static text) to exist, then swipes up to `attempts` times re-querying UITestFind.row until the row exists and is safely hittable; if still not found swipes down up to `attempts` times. Returns the last row query (possibly non-existent).

branches.effect: wait up to 8s for any static text, then continue regardless

branches.cond: row not existing+hittable and tries < attempts
row not found and tries < attempts (upward sweep)
branches.effect: swipe down and re-query; return final row

units.does: Up to `attempts` (3) times: on the last attempt terminates, relaunches and re-walks gates (toMainUI); selects the More tab, finds the row by identifier/label, waits 5*attempt s, polls hittability 3s, then taps it and returns true. Returns false after all attempts.

branches.effect: terminate + relaunch app with same launch args (re-runs -UITests-FreshInstall wipe if present) + toMainUI

branches.cond: row does not appear in 5*attempt s
row not hittable and before deadline

branches.effect: continue; else tap and return true

branches.effect: return false; else tap and return true

units.does: Presses Home, waits up to 10s for background, re-activates the app and waits for foreground, so scene-phase change flushes settings and defaults before a terminate.

Walks every first-run and paywall gate (walk) until none is present and the tab bar exists, then polls up to 20s for the tab bar to be safely hittable; returns that hittability (false if a gate remains).

branches.cond: a gate is still present or no tab bar after walk
tab bar not safely hittable and before deadline
branches.effect: sleep 100ms and re-poll; return final hittability

units.does: Walks only the first-run gates until the paywall skip button appears or no first-run gate remains; returns true if paywall.skipDebug is present or appears within 30s.

branches.effect: return true; else wait up to 30s for paywall.skipDebug

units.does: Waits up to 20s for the tab bar, then until timeout repeatedly checks isDone and otherwise dismisses one gate, waiting 2s for a static text when nothing was tappable. Returns silently on timeout.

branches.effect: wait up to 2s for any static text; else loop immediately

units.does: Returns whether any gate identifier resolves to an existing button.
Resolves all buttons matching the identifier from one snapshot and returns the first, or app.buttons[identifier] when none match.

For each gate identifier: skips missing buttons; if the button is disabled, swipes the disclaimer's scroll view (disclaimer.scroll, else first scroll view) up to 8 times until enabled; taps the first enabled, safely hittable gate and returns true. Returns false when nothing was tapped.

branches.effect: iterate in order disclaimer.agree, onboarding.skip, onboarding.advance, paywall.skipDebug
scroll the disclaimer to enable it
?: use it; else scrollViews.firstMatch (may be the dashboard behind the cover)

branches.cond: for up to 8 swipes while button still disabled

branches.effect: tap, return true; else next gate

units.does: Sets continueAfterFailure=false, creates XCUIApplication, appends launch arguments -UITests, -UITests-FreshInstall and English locale (UITestLanguage.english), launches the app (the app wipes onboarding/disclaimer/paywall flags, settings files and the session archive via AppLaunchRecovery.resetUITestStateIfRequested) and walks every first-run gate with UITestLaunch.toMainUI, ignoring its Bool result.
